name: Process Proxy Execution Via Squirrel.EXE
description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" binary to execute arbitrary processes. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Expected FP with some Electron based applications such as (1Clipboard, Beaker Browser, Caret, Discord, GitHub Desktop, etc.)
query: ((process.executable:(*\\squirrel.exe OR *\\update.exe)) AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-processStart* OR *\-\-processStartAndWait* OR *\-\-createShortcut*))) AND (NOT ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\AppData\\Local\\Discord\\Update.exe* AND process.command_line:*\ \-\-processStart* AND process.command_line:*Discord.exe*) OR ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\AppData\\Local\\GitHubDesktop\\Update.exe* AND process.command_line:*GitHubDesktop.exe*) AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-createShortcut* OR *\-\-processStartAndWait*))) OR ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\Update.exe* AND process.command_line:*Teams.exe*) AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-processStart* OR *\-\-createShortcut*))) OR ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\AppData\\Local\\yammerdesktop\\Update.exe* AND process.command_line:*Yammer.exe*) AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-processStart* OR *\-\-createShortcut*)))))
